scope: Existing illustrative plant, every configuration family and implemented service system; London, Seville and Copenhagen. No production default or repair capability changes.
questions: Which mechanisms preclude defensible numerical calibration?
Which conclusions survive joint parameter stress?
What observations would support a calibration and an independent validation?
calibration_rule: No fitted plant parameter without matching observations, measurement uncertainty, operating conditions, identifiable parameters and separate validation. Literature targets and other plants are context only.
uncertainty_rule: Exploratory ranges are not probability distributions or confidence intervals. Cross-factor combinations are retained including failures. No requirement that MPC win.

study.weather: Reproducible synthetic paired weather for plant stress; cached European weather inspected separately without substitution.

preservation: Earlier field-realism experiments and paused programme queue remain untouched. Review artifacts, numerical source identities, failures and inputs saved in this directory.
completion_gate: All reference configuration paths classified; consequential mechanisms reviewed with sources or explicit gaps; independent checks and conditional sensitivity reported; UI distinguishes chosen, assumed, source-supported and measured evidence; old archives retain original context. Real-plant calibration may remain blocked by absent measurements.
